title: Etale line frames give ordinary unit-valued descent data
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}(u:U\to X)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Modules on a site and their morphisms mean sheaves of modules and all module morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$-module, let $(u_a:U_a\to X)_{a\in I}$ be an arbitrary set-indexed jointly surjective etale family, and suppose given module-sheaf frames $t_a:\mathcal O_{U_a,\mathrm{et}}\simeq G|_{(U_a)_{\mathrm{et}}}$. For $R_{ab}=U_a\times_XU_b$, restrict both frames to $(R_{ab})_{\mathrm{et}}$. There is a unique unit $g_{ab}\in\Gamma(R_{ab},\mathcal O_{R_{ab}})^\times$ such that $t_a^{-1}t_b$ acts on every etale $q:W\to R_{ab}$ by $b\mapsto bq^\sharp(g_{ab})$. It is given by $g_{ab}=(t_a^{-1}t_b)_{\mathrm{id}_{R_{ab}}}(1)$, and its inverse is $(t_b^{-1}t_a)_{\mathrm{id}_{R_{ab}}}(1)$. On $U_a\times_XU_b\times_XU_c$, the functions satisfy $p_{ab}^*g_{ab}\,p_{bc}^*g_{bc}=p_{ac}^*g_{ac}$; on the diagonal $\Delta_a:U_a\to R_{aa}$ they satisfy $\Delta_a^*g_{aa}=1$. Multiplication by $g_{ab}$ gives ordinary module isomorphisms $p_b^*\mathcal O_{U_b}\simeq p_a^*\mathcal O_{U_a}$ on $R_{ab}$, using tensor-unit identifications for scheme module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. These form descent data, in the orientation from the $b$ factor to the $a$ factor, with the stated cocycle and diagonal normalization. No assumption that $g_{aa}$ is identically $1$ on all of $R_{aa}$ is made.

source.place: Tag 03DX, proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent (2), proof: the overlap isomorphisms and omitted verification of their cocycle, specialized to rank-one frames.

proof.text: Restrict a frame by precomposition: on an etale $q:W\to R_{ab}$, the two frames are evaluated at $p_aq:W\to U_a$ and $p_bq:W\to U_b$. Both targets are $G(W\to X)$, because $u_ap_aq=u_bp_bq$. The source in either case is $\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$. This uses the object and morphism description of [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Thus $f_{ab}=t_a^{-1}\circ t_b$ and $h_{ab}=t_b^{-1}\circ t_a$ are inverse natural module isomorphisms on $(R_{ab})_{\mathrm{et}}$, with linear components as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Tag 03DX, proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent, proof: overlap isomorphisms and omitted cocycle verification, specialized to the given rank-one frames.

proof.text: Put $R=R_{ab}$ and $s=(f_{ab})_{\mathrm{id}_R}(1)$. Naturality along $q:W\to R$ gives $(f_{ab})_q(1)=q^\sharp(s)$, since restriction sends $1$ to $1$. By componentwise $\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$-linearity [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], for every $b\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$ one has $(f_{ab})_q(b)=(f_{ab})_q(b\cdot1)=bq^\sharp(s)$. The identical calculation for $h_{ab}$ gives $(h_{ab})_q(b)=bq^\sharp(r)$, where $r=(h_{ab})_{\mathrm{id}_R}(1)$.

source.place: Tag 03DX, proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent, proof: overlap isomorphisms and omitted cocycle verification, specialized to the given rank-one frames.

proof.text: Evaluate $f_{ab}\circ h_{ab}=\mathrm{id}$ and $h_{ab}\circ f_{ab}=\mathrm{id}$ at $\mathrm{id}_R$ and $1$. The formulas in step 2 give $rs=1$ and $sr=1$. Therefore the pair $(s,r)$ defines a unit $g_{ab}$ with precisely the value and inverse asserted. If another unit has the asserted action, evaluation at $q=\mathrm{id}_R$ and $b=1$ identifies its underlying element with $s$; inverses are unique, so the units agree. This is just the definition of a unit in the commutative ring $\Gamma(R,\mathcal O_R)$.

source.place: Tag 03DX, proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent, proof: overlap isomorphisms and omitted cocycle verification, specialized to the given rank-one frames.

proof.text: On $T=U_a\times_XU_b\times_XU_c$, evaluate the three pulled-back frames on the same etale object $W\to T$. Cancellation gives $(t_a^{-1}t_b)\circ(t_b^{-1}t_c)=t_a^{-1}t_c$. By step 2, at $W=T$ and $1$ the left side is $(p_{bc}^*g_{bc})(p_{ab}^*g_{ab})$ and the right side is $p_{ac}^*g_{ac}$. Commutativity gives the displayed cocycle in the stated order, as an equality of units. For the diagonal write $p_1,p_2:R_{aa}\to U_a$ and $\Delta=\Delta_a$. Morphisms of $(U_a)_{\mathrm{et}}$ are $U_a$-morphisms [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], so $\Delta$ is a morphism from $\mathrm{id}_{U_a}$ to $p_1$ and to $p_2$; both give the same restriction $\rho$ of $G$ along the $X$-morphism $\Delta$, since $u_ap_1=u_ap_2$. Step 2 gives $(t_a)_{p_2}(1)=(t_a)_{p_1}(g_{aa})$. Applying $\rho$ and naturality of $t_a$ along $\Delta$ gives $(t_a)_{\mathrm{id}}(1)=(t_a)_{\mathrm{id}}(\Delta^\sharp g_{aa})$, and $(t_a)_{\mathrm{id}}$ is injective, so $\Delta_a^*g_{aa}=1$. No etaleness of $\Delta_a$ is used, and the two frames are not identified at arbitrary points of $R_{aa}$.

source.place: Tag 03DX, proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent, proof: overlap isomorphisms and omitted cocycle verification, specialized to the given rank-one frames.

proof.text: Use the canonical tensor-unit isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf], adjoint to the structure-sheaf map under [def-pc-module-pullback]. Multiplication by the global unit g_ab and by its inverse are inverse ordinary structure-module maps (Modules.smulHom_mul and smulHom_one). Define the b-to-a overlap map as theta_pb followed by multiplication by g_ab followed by theta_pa inverse. Its overlap coordinates are multiplication by g_ab, by cancellation of theta with its inverse.

source.place: Tag 0095, definition-pushforward, tensor formula for pullback; explicit tensor-unit maps and their compatibility.

proof.text: For a scheme map v and global function c, prove tensorPullback(v)(m_c) followed by theta_v equals theta_v followed by m_(v sharp c). Apply the tensor-pullback Hom adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback]. Since theta_v is adjoint to the structure map [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf], naturality of the Hom equivalence reduces the equation to m_c followed by that structure map equals that structure map followed by pushforward(m_(v sharp c)). Modules.pushforward_map_smulHom identifies the latter multiplication with m_c on the pushforward; Modules.smulHom_naturality proves the square. Conjugation therefore sends the scalar automorphism to multiplication by the pulled-back unit. The scalar multiplication composition law then turns the cocycle and diagonal equalities of step 4 into exactly the two asserted ordinary descent identities.
